title: Lake Victoria on the Tanzanian Side
excerpt: Lake Victoria is Africa's largest lake. On the Tanzanian side you find Mwanza, rocky shores and island life.
body:
## The lake

Lake Victoria is shared by Tanzania, Kenya and Uganda. It is the largest lake in Africa.

## Mwanza

Tanzania's second city lies on the lake, with rocky outcrops such as Bismarck Rock.

## Fishing

Fishing, including Nile perch and tilapia, is important for local communities.

## Rubondo Island

A national park in the lake. See [Rubondo](/blog/rubondo-island-national-park/).

## Combine

With the Western Serengeti. See [the Western Corridor](/blog/western-corridor-grumeti/).

## Health

Ask locally before swimming; bilharzia occurs in parts of the lake.

Read our [Mwanza page](/national-parks/mwanza/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
